author: Mauros96
quote:
Played on basic PS5
The game have really good graphic, map size and physics
And that's all

It's overhyped
The problem is, they put too much realism into this game, throwing most fun away, like putting RDR2 to GTA, this doesn't fit because this games have a different styles.  The story is poor writing. Beginning of the game is boring. The game picks up later on, after you’ve put in many hours but not too much. Jason and Lucia have no character. I feel like a playing The Sims than GTA, strange fellings. The Jason voice is also bad, no idea why they choose something like this but ok.

Even the problem is a content stuff. Of course they added new things but at the same time they removed things from the game that were in earlier parts of GTA, even the important ones.

Also it has a problem with framerate. The game not have 30fps on my basic PS5 except places outside of people or cars where there's not too much objects. It's mostly trying to targeting 30fps and it's getting worse if you drive into the most busy places or trying to destroy cars (explosions tooks a lot of fps). I bet, that on PS5 got more stable framerate but remember, most people have basic PS5, not a PRO model.

No worth to buy, especially the box version because there's no disk inside, only code. The cool thing is map game with poster on the other side.
